definitions.explanation: An outstanding or superb item, especially a product, dish, or work of art. Conveys a sense of refined quality and rarity.

examples.japanese: この{料理|りょうり}は{逸品|いっぴん}だ。
{職人|しょくにん}が{手作|てづく}りした{逸品|いっぴん}を{集|あつ}めた。
examples.english: I collected masterpieces handmade by craftspeople.

examples.japanese: この{美術館|びじゅつかん}には{江戸時代|えどじだい}の{逸品|いっぴん}が{数多|かずおお}く{展示|てんじ}されている。
examples.english: This museum displays many masterpieces from the Edo period.

notes:
Describes something of exceptionally high quality — a standout item among many. Often used for food, crafts, and artwork, but can apply to any product or creation. The word carries a tone of admiration and connoisseurship.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {知|し}る{人|ひと}ぞ{知|し}る{逸品|いっぴん} — a hidden gem known only to connoisseurs
- {逸品|いっぴん}ぞろい — a collection of fine items
- まさに{逸品|いっぴん} — truly a masterpiece
- {隠|かく}れた{逸品|いっぴん} — a hidden gem

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {一品|いっぴん} — a (single) dish or item; homophone but different nuance — refers to a single item/dish without implying excellence
- {名品|めいひん} — fine article, famous item; similar meaning but emphasizes fame or renown rather than pure quality
- {傑作|けっさく} — masterpiece; used more for creative works like literature, film, or art
